summary.text: Richard J. Cash is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 3 in Anderson County.
He was elected in a special election on May 30, 2017, to fill the unexpired term of Kevin L. Bryant, who became lieutenant governor.

paragraphs.text: Cash was born on March 31, 1960, in Jacksonville, Florida, and is a businessman.

His official page lists a B.A. in business administration from Furman University in 1982, graduating magna cum laude and Phi Beta Kappa, and an M.A.T.S. from Gordon-Conwell Theological Seminary in 1990.
His Senate committees are Education, Family and Veterans' Services, Judiciary, Medical Affairs and Rules.
